## Candidate Evaluation

### Required Qualifications

**Years of Experience (15/15)**
Nine years total professional experience, six specifically in payments infrastructure. Exceeds the 5+ year requirement comfortably. ✅

**Backend Language Proficiency (15/15)**
Strong demonstrated proficiency in both Python (FastAPI, production payments services) and Java (Spring Boot, logistics and payments). Core daily-use languages match the role precisely. ✅

**API Design & REST (10/10)**
Explicitly owns API design for a partner integration surface, maintains versioned REST contracts, and has documentation responsibility. Directly on-point. ✅

**Database & SQL (9/10)**
PostgreSQL and SQL listed; used in production services (merchant onboarding, freight tracking batch jobs). Solid evidence, though no mention of schema design scale or advanced tuning. Near full marks. ✅

**Cloud Platform – AWS (10/10)**
AWS listed with specific service-level detail: ECS, SQS, RDS, Lambda. Concrete, hands-on evidence. ✅

**CI/CD & Automated Testing (8/10)**
GitHub Actions listed; introduced automated integration testing at prior role. Less explicit detail on CI/CD pipeline ownership/design, but clear practical experience. ✅

**Education / Equivalent Experience (4/5)**
No degree; however, the JD explicitly allows "equivalent practical experience." Nine years of progressive engineering experience plus a structured apprenticeship satisfies this clause. Minor deduction only because equivalency requires interpretation. ✅

---

### Preferred Qualifications

**Event-driven / Message Brokers (5/5)**
Built an event pipeline using both Kafka and SQS for transaction state management. Directly matches preferred criteria. ✅

**Containers & Orchestration (5/5)**
Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm listed; standardized Helm charts across six services in current role. Strong evidence. ✅

**Infrastructure-as-Code (5/5)**
Terraform modules explicitly mentioned as a project deliverable in current role. ✅

**Financial Services / Payments Domain (5/5)**
Six years in payments infrastructure covering ACH, card settlement, and merchant onboarding. Exceptional domain alignment. ✅

**Observability Tooling (5/5)**
Grafana and Prometheus listed in skills. ✅

**Mentorship / Technical Leadership (4/5)**
On-call rotation lead, runs incident retrospectives for the payments domain. Strong signal for technical leadership. Mentorship of junior engineers not explicitly called out. ✅

Trevor Lindquist is an exceptionally strong match.
